# Backtest Report: Week of 2025-09-02 to 2026-08-21

## Assumptions
- Data: yfinance 1-min RTH bars; walk-forward replay through SignalRunner.detect_signals
- $1000 risk per trade, 2R target -> win +$2000, loss -$1000, scratch = R x $1000 at EOD close
- Stop+target same bar counted as loss (conservative)
- Repeat fires of same setup deduped by level (2 bars)

## Summary
- Traded signals (A+/A/B, viable stop): **3339** | 1832W 1478L 29 scratch | win rate 55.3% (of decided)
- Simulated P&L (traded all A+/A/B): **+$1895398.38**
- C-grade alerts (alert-only per SPEC2): 1578 | D filtered: 57346 | tight-stop skips: 2127
